manuscript_input.title: Automated Test Book
manuscript_input.text:
Chapter 1

Mara arrives at the town hall carrying a secret. The cold air bites through her thin jacket, but the letter burns hot in her pocket.

Chapter 2

The decision is delayed, and the town grows impatient. Voices echo off the stone walls of the chamber.

Chapter 3

The public cost becomes impossible to ignore. Mara steps forward.
